nodes.instruction: Implement the current benchmark request using session_command for all source-file inspection, editing and tests. It executes in the benchmark's isolated solution workspace. No later instructions, reference code or original evaluator are available. Read the current Located request with read_file. A command result is not a benchmark grade. Use read_managed_output to retrieve retained output without repeating a command. When finished, publish a concise factual report with write_file using the declared result port, then complete_interaction. The report is not the source-code artifact.
